blocks.text: Cell-mediated immunity T cells anjaam dete hain. Yeh ghair maamooli (abnormal) ya virus-infected cells ko maar kar jism ko virus infections aur cancer se bachati hai. Is mein cytotoxic T cells infected jismani cells ko pehchan kar tabah karte hain. In ka maarne ka tareeqa natural killer cells jaisa hai, yaani yeh target cells (infected cells ya ghair maamooli cancer cells) ki membranes mein soorakh kar dete hain. Cell-mediated immunity ke ahem waqiyat yeh hain:

items: Proliferation (tadaad barhna): Fa'al helper T cell ghulne wale (soluble) chemicals banata hai, maslan T cell growth factor. Yeh factor har qism ke T cells ki tadaad barhana shuru kar deta hai, aur antigens pehchanne wale T cells ke bare clones (aik jaise cells ke groups) ban jate hain.
Activation: Fa'al helper T cell aik doosra factor chhorta hai jo macrophages ko infection ki jagah khench lata hai.
Induction: Helper T cells thymus mein inducer T cells ko fa'al karte hain, jo lymphocytes ko T cells mein pukhta (mature) karna shuru karte hain.

Attack (hamla): Cytotoxic T cells ki satah par maujood receptors infected jismani cells ko pehchante hain, is liye yeh T cells infected cells se chipak jate hain. Yeh infected cells ki membrane tor dete hain aur cells phat jate hain.

Suppression (rokna): Suppressor T cells cytotoxic T cells ka jawab rok dete hain. Suppressor T cells ki tadaad cytotoxic T cells se ahista barhti hai. Shuru mein in ki kam tadaad ki wajah se yeh cytotoxic hamle ko nahin rok pate. Lekin 1 se 2 hafton ke baad in ki tadaad itni ho jati hai ke yeh cytotoxic T cells ka jawab band kar dete hain.

Memory (yaad): Suppression ke baad T cells ki aik aabadi baqi reh jati hai, shayad insaan ki poori umr ke liye. Yeh helper aur cytotoxic T cells ab memory cells kehlate hain. Agar wahi microbe dobara aaye to yeh foran tez jawab dete hain.

blocks.alt: Shaakhon wala silsila. Macrophage ke banaye proteins helper T-cell mein waqiyat shuru karte; yeh activated helper T-cell ban kar ghulne wale maadde (soluble factors) chhorta. Teen shaakhein: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf khenchna; T-cells ki afzaish; aur inducer T-cell jis se lymphocytes T-cells mein pukhta hote. Barhe hue T-cells se cytotoxic T-cells (infected cell par hamla), suppressor T-cells (jawab rokna) aur memory cells (aainda ke liye) bante.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sab kuch macrophage se shuru hota hai: us ke proteins helper T-cell ko fa'al karte hain. Fa'al helper T-cell ke soluble factors teen kaam karte hain: macrophage ko infected cell ki taraf bulate hain, T-cells ki tadaad barhate hain, aur inducer T-cell ke zariye naye T-cells pukhta karwate hain. Barhe hue T-cells teen kaam baant lete hain: cytotoxic (maarna), suppressor (rokna) aur memory (yaad rakhna).
